## Purpose
A skill document ("Mistral MCP Server — Build & Deployment Skill") for building, debugging and deploying a remote MCP server to be registered as a Mistral Connector. It covers transport selection (Streamable HTTP, spec 2025-03-26, versus the legacy SSE), server structure with FastMCP, Railway deployment and debugging.

## Accuracy
Generally accurate guidance for its topic. It is not specific to this repo's code; it relates to the external dynamic MCP tool server described in `analysis.md`. The facts about Mistral's connector API were current as of 2026-08 (when the API was in public preview).

## Used by
Claude or other agents and developers building MCP servers. It has skill front matter (name `mistral-mcp-server`).

## Replication notes
Copy it verbatim if the MCP-server work is in scope; it is not needed to run the platform.
